QuestInfo.name: Spiegelmann's Request
QuestInfo.0:
Spiegelmann has a favor to ask of you.
Visit him in the Monster Park.
QuestInfo.1: If you find a suspicious item in Monster Park, Spiegelmann wants it immediately. You can't look inside, either...
QuestInfo.2: At Spiegelmann's request, you brought back an #t2430290#. What could be inside?

0.0: Good to see you! You're doing well, yes? Right, I was wondering if you could give me a hand with something...\r\n#L0##bSure. What is it?#l\n#k
0.1: While exploring the Monster Park, there is a small chance you could come across something...shall we say, suspicious. Like an #b#t2430290##k, for example. If you were to find one, I would like you to bring it directly back to me.\r\n#L0#An #b#t2430290#? What's inside?#l\n#k
0.2: THAT is none of your business. Do NOT open it. Bring it straight back to me, WITHOUT opening it.\r\n#L0##bHm... If you say so.#l\n#k
0.3: Good. Now, bring it right back to me if you find it. #rAnd don't open it!#k

no.0: Fine, be that way. I'll find a NICE person to help me.

1.0: Did you find it? The #t2430290#? You didn't open, did you?

yes.0: Ha! Thank you kindly. You've really helped me out. Oh, and don't worry about what's inside. It's...nothing important. Anyway, enjoy your stay at the Monster Park!
